steps.body: Now run it in reverse: shown a frame-and-extras picture, NAME the teen. Count the extras, put “ten and” in front, and the numeral appears.
steps.narration: Now run it in reverse: shown a frame-and-extras picture, NAME the teen. Count the extras, put “ten and” in front, and the numeral appears.

widget.prompt: Seventeen is a full box of ten crayons plus 7 loose ones. Tap to build those 7 loose crayons.

commonCounts.feedback: 0 loose crayons leaves 7 still missing — seven taps build the loose crayons that make seventeen.
6 loose crayons leaves 1 still missing — one more tap completes the seven loose crayons.
8 loose crayons adds 1 too many — only 7 loose crayons are what seventeen needs.

widget.missFeedback: You already know the ten crayons are done; tap 7 loose crayons to make seventeen.
widget.successFeedback: The 7 loose crayons are built — one full box of ten, plus 7 more, is exactly seventeen.

predict.prompt: Full frame, 7 dots outside. Which teen?
predict.reveal: The outsiders ride on a finished ten; the name must carry both parts.

cml.actionGoal: Build one complete ten, then count on the ones, for knb identify teen.
invariants: Every teen number is one complete ten and some ones — the left digit records the finished ten, the right digit counts the extras — and that split is what knb identify teen rests on.
misconceptions: Reading the 1 of a teen as “one” instead of one TEN, or counting only the leftover ones and forgetting the completed ten.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: If one more dot joined the ones, which teen would the frame show then?

widget.prompt: A frame shows a full ten and 4 outside. Which teen is it?

options.label: 4 — just the outsiders
options.feedback: Counting only the extras drops the completed ten; the whole group is ten and four.

options.label: 14 — ten and four
options.feedback: Correct — one complete ten and 4 ones is exactly what the numeral 14 records.

options.label: 40 — four and a zero
options.feedback: 40 means four TENS; here there is one ten and four ones, which is 14.

options.label: 10 — the frame alone
options.feedback: The frame's ten is only part of the group; the 4 outside push the total to 14.

widget.prompt: What number comes right before 16? Hop one back and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: 16 stops one complete hop too soon. Continue the final 1-unit hop back to reach 15.
14 goes one complete hop too far. Count exactly 1 hop back from 16 to reach 15.

widget.missFeedback: Count 1 back from 16: you land on 15.
widget.successFeedback: 15 — one hop back through the teens, one less than 16.
widget.lowFeedback: Short of the landing — one hop back from 16 reaches 15.
widget.highFeedback: Past the landing — right before 16 means a single hop back, stopping on 15.
